bullets.content: [general] After solve 1, read the top-5 hotspots' nearest group and local h. Put the next refinement on the edge or group of the largest hotspot at ~0.5x its local h, not where you assumed the error would be.

[general] The LAST mesh() call is the one solve() uses. Right before every solve(), re-issue the exact recipe, check nodes and min_quality>=0.1, and that the node count matches. A quality-0.096 mesh wasted a solve.

[general] Meshing is deterministic and pricing is free, solves are not. Check node count against baseline before solving; never solve a mesh with more nodes than the baseline without a new refinement target (a6 solved h 0.013 at 6565 vs 5705 nodes). Above 2x target score=g/(2c).
[general] After the candidate solve call view(kind=error); read top-5 hotspot shares and local h before choosing the next experiment. Do not spend an experiment on a 3.6% target.

[general] Never call compare(a,a). Call compare(prev,new) after each solve; stress_diff below ~11% at the same DOFs is re-meshing noise. Only a change that moves local h at the top hotspot by >=1.5x gives a readable signal.
[general] Change one factor per solve; write the changed factor in the thought before each mesh call. Multi-factor solves (edge removal + box + size) cannot be attributed.
[general] After solve 1, call view(1,kind=error,view=-z) and view(1,kind=error,view=iso). Note the z of the top 5 hotspots and place refinements at that z, not 2-4 mm away.
[general] Never spend a solve on a mesh coarser than your best under-target mesh (h 0.012 gave eta 0.12 vs 0.101). Make the last solve a one-factor refinement test at the top hotspot.
[general] Compare solves by energy first, then DOFs. Do not spend a solve on a placement tweak for a hotspot only 1 mm outside a box without evidence it changes field error.

[general] Before submitting, estimate score=(g/2)^2/c per candidate using compare-based trends. Above target pick by e*DOFs: equal energy at fewer DOFs wins (15687 vs 16122 DOFs, same 2.1313e-4 J, base 0.760).
[general] Reference-free eta underestimated true field error by ~35% (0.101 vs 13.8%). If best eta is above ~0.085, assume the target is missed and refine at the hotspot strip before submitting.

[general] Name the binding term after each run. For a6 points (9.71%) bound over field (8.01%) and cost 0.12 base. When check-point RMS is within 1% of field error, add coverage over low-stress regions, not more clamp refinement.

[general] Coarse h saves DOFs only with one smoothly graded refinement (h 0.0125 + single 0.0042 box r0.005 gave 14.9k DOFs). With several boxes at <=0.25x h, gradings add nodes. Test coarse h by node count first.

[general] Box radius is often ignored at these scales (a9: upper r0.004/0.007/0.012 gave identical 5705 nodes; a7 tier1 r0.003 vs 0.006 identical). For strong grading use point refinements, where size and radius define grading directly, and price them.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Top 4 hotspots in every run are at f16/f19 boss-body junctions, z~0.03, ~3.5% error energy each (submitted mesh h 0.0064 there). Keep edges 8 and 39 at size 0.003, r 0.005 whenever h>0.005.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Solve 2: h 0.0065 with same refinements. Use compare(1,2) to measure field change per DOF, then submit the one with the better estimated (g/2)^2/c.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] The 4 top-ring clamp cells at z~0.056 hold ~18% of error energy (local errors 170-380%, h 0.0046). Add box [-0.015,-0.02,0.050,0.015,0.02,0.0575] at 0.003 r0.004 instead of the uniform 0.0052 body box. Edges 3/5 are a valid alternative earning diversity.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Second error band: f20/f12 intersection ring at z 0.022-0.027 (2-3.6% per hotspot, local h ~0.005). If a free solve remains, test {group:f20, size 0.0035, radius 0.004} as a separate experiment, not as the submitted variant.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Junction hotspots f19/f20 z 0.022-0.031 stay h 0.0046 (VM err 15-22%); box 0.0038 only gave 0.0046. Try 0.003 with thinner z 0.021-0.032, or f16/f19 0.0035 r0.01. Separate experiment.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Skip h 0.009 starts: all 8 agents found them too coarse (energy ~0.0299 vs ~0.0336 fine). Spend solve 1 on the variant mesh and solve 2 on one controlled change.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Uniform h reduction is expensive and score got worse (h 0.0045: 8195 nodes, energy 0.03358 vs 0.03260 at h 0.006). Keep base h ~0.007-0.008 and spend elements locally; keep a distinct local-refinement recipe for diversity.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] f2 at 0.003 gave h 0.0045; support carries little error. Try f2 0.004 to save DOFs as a controlled experiment; the clamp cells at z~0.056 still need refinement, so verify with compare.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Replace whole-body 0.0052 box with coarser body (h 0.0065-0.007) plus two bands (z 0.050-0.0575 and z 0.021-0.032); 61% of elements sit in low-error cells. Aim for same DOFs, field error below 18.1%.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Drop point refinements at check points P0/P3 (0.003 r0.004): check errors were already 4-7%; score is bound by field error. Edge refinements 39/8/40 gave only marginal change.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] The binding term is FIELD error (17.5-24.2% field vs 6-13% check-point in all runs). Judge meshes by compare() stress_diff_energy_norm_rel and the error view, not local values.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Score vs DOFs is nearly flat: h 0.007 -> 0.231 at 11.4k DOFs; 0.006 -> 0.218 at 15k; 0.0045 -> 0.207 at 24k. Field error falls only ~N^-0.46, so only moving DOFs into hotspot bands pays.
[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Choosing by error-squared times DOFs worked. Keep the cheaper candidate unless field error falls by more than 10%.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Call compare(a,b) after every solve from solve 2 on, and view(solve, kind=error) once. Use the top-5 hotspots of solve 1 to drive the solve 2 mesh, not an energy-convergence guess.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Setup (f2 fixed, 4 MPa f23, 2.1 MPa f16, E 210 GPa, nu 0.3) is correct, equilibrium holds; reuse verbatim. Curved-face net force variation is facet noise.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Highlight a4 (rank 1, field 8.15%, 17115 DOFs, +0.1 diversity): one bottom box [0.014,-0.016,-0.0081,0.029,0.016,-0.0066] 0.0016 r0.007 gives hotspot h 0.0025-0.0028; upper box 0.0038 beat 0.0045 (6.1% field change for +3.8% DOFs).

[abc_00000065_bc0] Coarse h is NOT a lever with a 0.0016 bottom box: h 0.0125/0.013/0.0135 gave 6529 (q 0.072, invalid), 6565, 8085 nodes vs 5705 at h 0.008 (~19.7k DOFs, no saving vs h 0.007). Grading adds nodes. Keep h 0.008; stop testing coarse h.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Baseline: h 0.007, tier1 0.0018 r0.003, tier2 0.0034, f7 0.0035 r0.006, upper 0.0045: 15687 DOFs, 8.92% field, score 0.823; fewer DOFs beat the 0.0016 box (18.4k DOFs, 8.01%) since cost dominates once target met.

[abc_00000065_bc0] h 0.007 on a4 recipe: 6130 nodes, 2.13604e-4 J vs 5705 nodes, 2.13564e-4 at h 0.008 (+7.4% DOFs for +0.02% energy), points rose to 9.71%. Never submit h 0.007 when h 0.008 has q>=0.1.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Points can bind. a4 narrow-y bottom frame (|y|<=0.016) gave point RMS 8.06-9.71%; a12 frame with y -0.026..0.024 gave 6.1-6.3%. Always cover -y bottom to y -0.026..-0.028 at <=0.0036.
[abc_00000065_bc0] +y corner hotspot near f8/f43 (0.0225,0.0198,-0.005): 5.3-5.7% of error at h 0.005, VM error 9-12%, outside peers' boxes. Point 0.003 r0.004; check f38/f43 h <=0.004.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Solve plan: S1 point-cluster recipe, view error iso, read hotspot h. S2 one change (point size 0.0015 if hotspot h >0.0027, else drop -y band). S3 x0.75 reference. S4 best combination.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Calibration: compare(candidate, 30.8k reference) gave 0.0684-0.068 for true 8.0% field error (factor ~1.17). compare cannot see check points; judge point risk by -y and +y coverage. Score by e^2*DOFs; prefer cheaper unless error drops >10%.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Peers at h 0.008: a14 5277 nodes 2.13341e-4 J; a7 5159 nodes 2.13235e-4; a4 5705 nodes 2.13564e-4. Submit yours if energy per node >= these and nodes <=5500.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Clamp layer z~-0.0072 beside f5/f7 holds ~31-33% of error at h 0.0025, VM error 3.5-4.5%: saturated (peers at 0.0022 still 30%). Don't refine below 0.0016 requested; spend DOFs on +y corner and -y band.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Widening tier1 ymin -0.012 to -0.016 cost +435 DOFs for no energy change (2.1315e-4 vs 2.1313e-4). Only box a hotspot with >=7% error energy whose local h is >1.3x requested.
